item.title: Nvidia says AI labs it is helping to finance will be about a quarter of next year's business
item.summary: Nvidia has put a figure on its exposure to the AI labs it helps fund. On its second-quarter earnings call, chief financial officer Colette Kress said the company expects "demand from the AI labs for which we expect to leverage our balance sheet to contribute toward roughly a quarter of our business next year." That single sentence reframes the financing question. The issue is no longer whether Nvidia supports its customers' balance sheets, but that a quarter of forecast revenue now depends on structures the company itself has arranged.
